trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work the roadmap below in order: story first, missables as you go, stranger strands second, then the long clean-up grinds last.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Unmissable story trophy — play through the prologue and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Unmissable story trophy; keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable story trophy. Two long grinds open in this chapter: garage properties after the Daily Driver mission, and the Scooter Bros app after Moses — see Little Boxes and On the Spot.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable story trophy. Warning: the timed stranger step Race Against Yago happens in this chapter — see Strangers & Freaks before you move on.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable story trophy. Bank-vault robberies open at the end of this chapter, after the mission That's Where The Money Is — see Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Gold, unmissable story trophy — the end of the campaign.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: the story, every stranger strand, all collectibles, activities and challenges. The in-game stats screen tracks your percentage — use this checklist as the mop-up list once the story is done, and keep going past 250 stunts: 100% wants 300.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — stunt jumps and similar feats all count. Chain them while travelling instead of hunting them one by one; the 100% completion target is 300, so do not stop at this trophy.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once: a race, a round at the shooting range, a fishing trip, an arcade game, and the rest. Dip into each activity icon on the map rather than grinding one.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across both ranges. Learn each range's scoring, pick a steady weapon you control well, and retry single challenges until gold — you do not need to gold them all in one visit.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. The drone handles the same on every course, so learn each track's tight turns and shortcuts instead of relying on speed.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any mix of race types counts, but each race only counts once — work through new events instead of repeating one you already won.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot, watch the tension meter, and reel steadily instead of mashing the button.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish any arcade cabinet game from start to end. Starting one is not enough.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the stranger mission strands. Follow Andy's strand through its missions to the last one.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, one of the stranger mission strands. Follow Kenton's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, one of the stranger mission strands. Follow Billy's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. One step is timed: in Chapter 3, Race Against Yago must be done when it appears — miss it and the strand stalls. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, one of the stranger mission strands. Follow Randy's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, one of the stranger mission strands. Follow Tyrone's strand through to its last mission.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. The first spot is the balcony in Chapter 1 — walk past it and it is gone for the whole playthrough, because there is no mission replay and no second run. Meditate at every marked spot you find after that, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand to the hunt; the target is a one-off animal, so track it patiently and do not scare it off before the shot.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are tucked away across Leonida — shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots — so sweep each district as you explore it and check the collection screen for the sets you still need.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are scattered all over the map, so work district by district instead of criss-crossing Leonida and re-covering ground.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and activities — the challenges menu shows what is left, so clear the easy ones first and let the rest fill in as you play.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay outside the search area until it clears.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep each robbery quick, and do not let the wanted level drop between them.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in and drive 100 different vehicle models. Variety counts, not repeats: try new cars, bikes, boats and aircraft whenever you find them.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies together first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain all five takedowns before the meter runs out.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At the airport, find a passenger jet at the E3/E4 jet bridges and take it — no ticket, no schedule.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Find the tank south of Mile Zero Air Station and take it for a spin — expect the military to object, so have an escape plan.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The quiet approach uses the Snap Gun, which comes from the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs strand — use it, stay out of sight lines, and leave before any alarm.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open after the end-of-Chapter-4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Plan each robbery with an escape route ready before you go in.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the cops before the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named district and region. Drive, fly and walk the map edges; the stats screen shows which areas are still unvisited.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one operation per gang; gang turf on the map and your contacts point to the targets.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order the cocktail and take in the view.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full frame at the alley and finish your throw.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out strength with both protagonists — train with each of them until their strength stat is full.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This pops on a key story decision — play the campaign and choose when the moment comes; it cannot be forced early.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A repeat-attempt moment — if at first you don't succeed, try the same approach again.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? An out-of-the-ordinary encounter somewhere in Leonida — keep your eyes open while exploring off the beaten path.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past, swing a melee weapon and knock a target down — timing beats speed.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Launder steadily through the whole game; the total is cumulative, so bank the bills as you earn them.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Big purchases count fastest — vehicles, property and gear all add up toward the total.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties, about $160,000 in total. The property app opens after the Chapter 2 Daily Driver mission — buy each garage as funds allow.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Moses — register cars you drive regularly.
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy list, 18 Nov 2026 — Exophase & PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade; cross-checked against Push Square (18 Nov 2026), OutputLag and Keengamer. Gameplay detail: OutputLag / Keengamer GTA 6 trophy guides, Nov 2026.

meta.note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades are quoted from the official PS5 list. Guides are written in the entrant's own words and paraphrase, never copy, other guides.
